body.statement: For every \(m\in\mathcal M_{2,\mathrm{reg}}\) with \(D(P_m)\neq0\), the least \(K\in\{2,3\}\) for which the information \((T_2,\ldots,T_K)\) identifies \(\theta(m)=(a(m),d(m))^\top\) is \(K=3\). The intersection on which this conclusion holds is nonempty.
body.justification: Combining achievability with a legal lower-information fiber turns a sufficient third-order method into a sharp information frontier.
body.gap: No cited cyclic result establishes a least finite cumulant order for this projected structural query.
body.consumer: Study designers learn exactly which population summaries must be retained or estimated to distinguish the outer feedback coefficients.
